documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local csr_mv docstring accepts a CSRTensor and dense Tensor, returns a dense Tensor, and lists GPU and CPU as supported platforms.
MindSpore 2.9 local CSRTensor.mv docstring lists GPU and CPU as supported platforms and does not mention the LLVM precondition that appears on CSRTensor.sum/mm/to_csr.
The tested input has shape (2, 3), the dense vector has shape (3, 1), and PyNative returns a dense Tensor of shape (2, 1).
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: Graph mode fails before returning a dense result.
Not a general CSR unsupported issue: CSRTensor.to_tuple, astype, abs, and add controls pass in Graph mode on CPU.
Not an invalid shape issue: the matrix-vector dimensions are compatible and PyNative returns a Tensor with shape (2, 1).
The Graph error is localized to CSRMV CPU kernel metadata parsing: 'Parsed metadata of op[CSRMV] failed'.
